card.name: Small words opening a new clause
card.fires_on: Short function words like a, an, the, does, is that start a noun phrase or question right after in, among, with, why, what or where. Often in study descriptions about a group of people or in question titles.

modes.label: Article before a study group

modes.label: Question opener
modes.description: Does, is or what-type words starting a question or title about how or why something happens.
modes.example: "<<Does>> Your Language Shape How You Think?".
